verdict.rationale: Limitless publishes a first-party API reference with per-endpoint parameter documentation for lifelogs, chats and audio, plus an example repository showing how to call the Developer API. Nothing shows the reference is interactive, though, and probes found no OpenAPI spec that would power such tooling. Missing for 10: an interactive or try-it-in-browser API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
